claim: CategoryRepository.delete() is dead code and should be removed
rationale: Not dead: it is directly exercised by tests/features/categories/test_categories.py (test at ~line 94) and kept for API symmetry with the other repos. CategoryService.delete_category deliberately bypasses it with an inline commit-free DELETE because repo.delete() commits, which would end the service-owned transaction early and break the INV-7 delete-cascade atomicity (pinned by the INV-7 rollback test). The method is intentional, tested, and must not be removed. Two independent review lanes flagged it as 'dead in the service layer'; that is accurate but the 'remove it' conclusion is wrong.

rationale: Both are the bullet HEADLINE, which by this project's roadmap-format records the work as ORIGINALLY PROPOSED. In both cases the Resolved body immediately below documents the deviation explicitly and correctly. FIBR-0069 body: "Named _signed_balance (a single token) rather than the tentative _signed_balance_from_tokens, since every site passes one token" — and src/finbreak/importers/standard_bank.py:191 defines _signed_balance. FIBR-0068 body: "IMPORTANT distinction surfaced, not forced: kept DISTINCT from ImportWizardWidget._set_combo, which is UNGUARDED by design ... Merging them would have been a silent behavior change" — and src/finbreak/ui/_widgets.py:6-9 repeats that rationale in the module docstring, with select_combo_data at :27. A reviewer reading headline-only sees drift; reading the bullet sees an accurate, self-documenting record. Rewriting the headlines would DESTROY the proposed-vs-delivered contrast that makes the deviation legible. Applies to any shipped ants-v1 bullet: judge status claims agai…

Resolved all 107 dotted tokens against src/ + tests/: only 26 fail, and of those the majority are external APIs the docs legitimately cite (`QEvent.LanguageChange`, `os.execv`, `os.path.commonpath`, `locale.setlocale`, `QIcon.fromTheme`, `QTextCursor.insertImage`, `pikepdf._core`, ofxparse's `account.routing_number` at FIBR-0008:780) or filenames in prose (`SECURITY.md`, `finbreak_de.ts` cited as a Qt naming EXAMPLE at naming.md:181). claim: spec_code_drift: 5 of 6 "spec references `test_*.py` but no match in project sources" findings on tests/features/*/spec.md
rationale: All five cited files exist on disk in the same directory as the spec that cites them: tests/features/dashboard/test_min_size.py, tests/features/forecast/{test_forecast_service.py,test_importer_capture.py,test_preview_threading.py}, tests/features/spending_alerts/test_alerts_ui.py (verified by `ls` 2026-08-03). The detector evidently resolves citations against source_roots (src/) only and does not search test_roots, so every test-file citation in a test spec fires. The 6th finding of the batch (import_date_detect/spec.md:20, `test_added_strings_are_tr_wrapped_and_data_is_fixed_tokens`) was NOT dismissed — it is a genuine stale citation and was fixed in this sweep.
